text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During a meeting with Tanino Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Again?! My hidden right eye aches...!
Be still! Demon of agony!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At first glance, she seemed just as usual,
but she felt subtly different from the girl who always held a clear sense of 'aesthetic'...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Stay back, Trainer!
Right now, I am an unruly mob of uncontrollable pain!
I might just kick you to the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It seems I strained my eyes too much deciphering the forbidden grimoire.
I must take some headache medicine...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Forgive me, Trainer.
I cannot allow myself to become a shackle holding you back.
I shall disappear for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How completely baffling...!
At any rate... I really hope she takes care of herself.
